object_description: large independent square building volume with differentiated height development
design_condition: The volume is placed around the connecting green space with controlled distance from the existing complex and differentiated heights, but its scale overwhelms the pavilion ensemble and compresses the surrounding open space.

positive.statement: The careful site analysis provides a coherent conceptual starting point.
The existing construction period and delicate facade expression are preserved with care.
The learning landscape and flexible classroom divisions are pedagogically valuable.
The open ground floor is inviting and the spatial layers are well connected.
The project achieves effective summer heat protection and night cooling.

negative.statement: The large volume exceeds the scale of the pavilion school and puts pressure on the external space.
The outdoor-space design disregards the garden-monument qualities and fragments the generous lawn.
The large atrium is acoustically unsuitable for school use by this age group.
The interventions in the existing structure and surfaces are far too massive.
The building has poor economic characteristics and is the most expensive new building.
